name: AgentScout
description: AgentScout is a read-only directory of 2,065 AI agent tools, including 276 MCP servers, with link checks and pricing as makers state it. It has no chat or task endpoint; read the static JSON feeds below or use the read-only MCP server (https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp).
interaction: static, read-only files over HTTPS GET, plus a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP); no authentication; no A2A task endpoint

skills.name: Find AI agent tools
skills.description: Look up AI agent tools and MCP servers by category, pricing or name by reading api/tools.json or calling the MCP server at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp.
examples: List coding agents with open-source code.

skills.name: Compare Stripe listing packages & Made by AgentScout bots
skills.description: Read api/products.json (or /.well-known/acp.json) to compare AgentScout's 4 maker listing tiers ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) with direct Stripe Checkout URLs and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bot templates.
examples: How much does a 30-day category pin on AgentScout cost?
What pre-trained bots does AgentScout offer?
